title: Beyond the LC25000 ceiling: optimizer robustness and external validity of a convolutional network and a vision transformer for lung cancer histopathology classification
description: Final Revision R1 replication package (v2.1.0) aligned with CMPBUP-D-26-00450. Preserves all v2.0.0/v2.0.1 baselines untouched under logs_and_metrics/ and figures/, and adds Revision R1 experiments (WP01 shallow-feature shortcut test, WP02 synthetic near-duplicate audit validation, WP03 matched-recipe 3-seed benchmark, WP04a multi-seed replication, WP04b 7-point LR sweep with SGDM, WP04c warmup+cosine ablation, WP05 clean G1/G2 OOF exports, WP06 LungHist700 stain-norm zero-shot/HED/Phikon/CTransPath/tiling/domain-shift, WP07 lightweight Adebayo & spatially-matched XAI tests, single-session 3-model GPU compute benchmark, updated figures_rev1/, Statistik_CI_Kalibrasi_SensSpec.csv, and wp05_wp06_bootstrap_stats.py).
